description: List all available PDF specification documents. Returns document IDs, titles, page counts, and categories, plus `coverage.gaps` — the normative areas this corpus does NOT contain (PDF/A, PAdES). Read the gaps before concluding that a requirement does not exist. Use the returned IDs as the `spec` parameter in other tools.

category.description: Filter by category (standard, ts, pdfua, guide, appnote).

name: list_specs
title: List available specifications
